name: Varbase Reports
description: Provides a set of statistical reports (users, content) for Varbase/Drupal sites.
project_description:
Provides a list of statistical reports. Targeted about users, content, blocks. And be able to export data.

 

 

 
 Back to top 

 Varbase documentation 
 Check out Varbase documentation for more details.

 
 Features: 
 
 
 Varbase KPIs Users Reports 
 
 Registered users report 
 
 
 
 
 Varbase KPIs Content Reports 
 
 Created content report 
 
 Navigate to Reports \ Varbase Reports 

 

 The Varbase Reports page 

 

 The Registered Users report page 

 

 The Created Content Report page 

 

 Requires: 
 
 Better Exposed Filters module. 
 Views Date Format SQL module. 
 CSV Serialization module. 
 Views data export module. 
 
 

 
 

 Back to top 

 Use With Varbase Distribution: 
 This module is best used with Varbase distribution.

 Can be installed with any Drupal 9/10 site. Even if installed with the Minimal or Standard profile.

 However, using it with Varbase gives you way much more cool stuff!
